name: Url Purge Aggregator
description: Aggregate related URLs for cache purging via Purge.
project_description:
This module implements a queuer for the Purge module, allowing URLs to be queued for purging.

 The initial implementation is basic but functional, offering the ability to queue URLs for purging when nodes are edited or deleted. This is particularly useful in cases where CDNs or proxy caches do not support cache tag invalidation.

 The queuing functionality can be enabled or disabled, making it possible to use module for handling other types of entities using the service "url_purge_aggregator.queuer" — for example, documents associated with media entities or other custom content types.

 How to Install 
 When the module is installed, the queuer will be automatically activated.

 In the configuration form (/admin/config/development/url_purge_aggregator), you can choose whether to enable or disable node URL management.
